alex: quick heads-up — prepping a hotfix bump to 2.2.1 for the KV cache NPE seen in prod. aiming for minimal-diff cherry-pick and hotpatch release today. cutoff target: 18:00 UTC. can folks confirm availability for reviews + smoke? :hourglass:
maria: on it. cherry-pick is ready (abc123 -> def456). i'll open a tiny PR and tag reviewers, should be a 10–15m look.
jamal: oncall — please confirm rollback steps. also, do we have a canary region for a staged rollout?
sophie: sre here. canary is eu-west, we can ramp to 10% for 20m and run the smoke suite. i'll own the smoke checklist.
alex: PR link: https://git.internal/repo/pull/2345 — includes two small commits. apply locally:

```
git checkout -b hotfix/2.2.1-kv-npe
git cherry-pick -x abc123
git push origin hotfix/2.2.1-kv-npe
```

please include review comments inline.
maria: added changelog entry at changelogs/2.2.1.md — short note + attribution. @lee can you approve the release blurb?
lee: approved. keep it short; add "no data migration required" line and we're good.
jamal: do we need to bump the docker image tag? propose redwood/runtime:2.2.1-hotfix so it's explicit.
maria: bumped Dockerfile and built locally, pushing image to staging registry now.
deploy-bot: deploy started: hotfix/2.2.1 -> staging at 1769012500. CI: https://ci.internal/build/789
sophie: smoke tests started. running e2e + latency + KV stress. i'll report results in ~20m.
alex: if smoke passes, target prod cut at 18:30 UTC. rollback plan quick ref: infra/scripts/rollback_hotfix.sh — run with HOTFIX=2.2.1 and follow prompts. :white_check_mark:
jamal: noted. i'll be online at cutoff and +30m for post-deploy sweeps.
maria: quick ask — can someone tag security for a fast sanity scan? @sarah-sec
alex: tagged Sarah in the PR, thanks. will post final status here once staging smoke clears. :thumbsup:
